-- =====================================================================
-- Harbourline Insurance Brokers: sample dataset for the SQL & Databases course
-- Version 1.0 (2026-11-25). Fictional company, fictional people: any resemblance is coincidence.
--
-- Paste this whole file into: the PGlite playground, the Supabase SQL editor,
-- or psql / DBeaver / pgAdmin. It is safe to run again: it drops and recreates
-- its own tables first (it deletes ONLY the 7 tables listed below).
--
-- Works on PostgreSQL 16, 17, 18 and newer. No extensions needed.
--
-- Tables
--   insurers                  the insurance companies we place policies with
--   customers                 people and businesses we advise (with duplicates!)
--   policies                  insurance contracts: one customer, one insurer
--   renewals                  yearly renewal (prolongation) of a policy
--   premium_invoices          what we invoiced customers, per period
--   payments                  money we received from customers
--   insurer_statements        what each insurer says we owe/booked per month.
--                             It does NOT fully match our own records.
--
-- Deliberately messy: NULLs, duplicate customers, inconsistent casing and
-- spaces, policy numbers written differently by insurers, payments in several
-- time zones, timing differences between months, small amount differences.
-- =====================================================================

BEGIN;

DROP TABLE IF EXISTS insurer_statements, payments, premium_invoices, renewals, policies, customers, insurers CASCADE;

CREATE TABLE insurers (
    insurer_id        integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    code              text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    name              text NOT NULL,
    country           char(2) NOT NULL,
    time_zone         text NOT NULL,            -- IANA zone name, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam
    statement_cycle   text NOT NULL             -- how often they send a statement
);

CREATE TABLE customers (
    customer_id       integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    public_id         uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),   -- safe to show in URLs
    customer_type     text NOT NULL CHECK (customer_type IN ('person', 'business')),
    full_name         text NOT NULL,
    email             text,                    -- may be NULL, may be UPPERCASE
    phone             text,
    birth_date        date,                    -- NULL for businesses
    city              text,
    country           text,                    -- messy on purpose: 'NL', 'nl', 'Netherlands', ...
    created_at        timestamptz NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE policies (
    policy_id         integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_number     text NOT NULL UNIQUE,    -- our format: ABC-123456
    customer_id       integer NOT NULL REFERENCES customers (customer_id),
    insurer_id        integer NOT NULL REFERENCES insurers (insurer_id),
    product           text NOT NULL,
    start_date        date NOT NULL,
    end_date          date,                    -- NULL = no end date yet
    annual_premium    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,  -- current yearly premium in EUR
    payment_frequency text NOT NULL CHECK (payment_frequency IN ('monthly', 'quarterly', 'annual')),
    status            text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'suspended')),
    notes             text
);

CREATE TABLE renewals (
    renewal_id        integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    policy_id         integer NOT NULL REFERENCES policies (policy_id),
    renewal_date      date NOT NULL,
    old_premium       numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
    new_premium       numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
    status            text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('renewed', 'pending', 'declined')),
    processed_at      timestamptz              -- NULL while pending
);

CREATE TABLE premium_invoices (
    invoice_id        integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_number    text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    policy_id         integer NOT NULL REFERENCES policies (policy_id),
    invoice_date      date NOT NULL,
    due_date          date NOT NULL,
    period_start      date NOT NULL,
    period_end        date NOT NULL,
    amount            numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,  -- premium the customer must pay
    commission        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,  -- our share, kept from the premium
    status            text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open', 'paid', 'partially_paid', 'overdue', 'cancelled'))
);

CREATE TABLE payments (
    payment_id        integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id        integer REFERENCES premium_invoices (invoice_id),  -- NULL = not matched yet
    paid_at           timestamptz NOT NULL,
    amount            numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,
    method            text NOT NULL,
    reference         text                     -- free text typed by the customer or bank
);

CREATE TABLE insurer_statements (
    line_id           integer GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
    insurer_id        integer NOT NULL REFERENCES insurers (insurer_id),
    statement_month   date NOT NULL,           -- first day of the month the insurer booked it in
    policy_number     text NOT NULL,           -- as the INSURER writes it (formats differ!)
    invoice_reference text,                    -- often missing
    booking_date      date NOT NULL,
    amount            numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,  -- premium according to the insurer
    commission        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL,  -- commission according to the insurer
    line_type         text NOT NULL            -- premium, correction, cancellation_refund
);
